description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView used to display log messages received through the LogNode interface. It formats log data, handles UI thread updates, and chains to other LogNode instances.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data, implementing the LogNode interface, and capable of chaining log output to other LogNode instances.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs log data, determining log level as a string, converting exceptions to stack trace strings, and updating the UI thread with the log message.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends the log message as a new line in the LogView.
